payout_quote: Option 1: $425 Cash Bonus ... Earn a $425 bonus or gift when you open a new consumer checking account, subject to approval, and meet all the following requirements for your account type within 90 calendar days of account opening ... A minimum of 15 qualifying Visa debit card transactions have posted to your account; An aggregate of $500 in qualifying direct deposits have posted to your account. Account must be open a minimum of 90 days.
steps: Open a new CBT consumer checking account at https://www.communitybt.com/bonus (Iowa residents only; $25 minimum opening deposit; online openings default to the $425 credit).
Within 90 days of opening: make at least 15 qualifying Visa debit card purchases and receive an aggregate of $500 in qualifying direct deposits (P2P transfers may not qualify).
Keep the account open at least 90 days; the $425 bonus is paid within 30 days after the end of the 90-day qualifying period.
catches: Iowa residents only; offer valid 2026-07-01 through 2026-09-30 (subject to change or termination without notice).

Within 90 days of opening: at least 15 qualifying Visa debit card purchases (point-of-sale only, no ATM) AND an aggregate of $500 in qualifying direct deposits; P2P transfers may not count as direct deposit.
Account must be open a minimum of 90 days; bonus paid within 30 days after the end of the 90-day qualifying period.
Limited to one bonus per tax identification number; clients who previously received a new account bonus are not eligible; cannot combine with other offers.
BankOn Checking not eligible; $25 minimum opening deposit; early closing fee may apply.
Bonus will be reported as interest on Form 1099-INT (standard).
biggest_catch: Iowa residents only, and you wait ~120 days for payout: account must be open 90 days and the bonus posts within 30 days after that period ends.
